citation: Hayes et al. (2017), Tectonic Summaries of Magnitude 7 and Greater Earthquakes from 2000 to 2015, USGS Open-File Report 2016-1192
evidence_used: Event-specific tectonic summaries for M7+ Andean megathrust, outer-rise, and deep-slab events from 2000 through 2015 (including 2010 M8.8 Maule, 2014 M8.2 Iquique, 2015 M8.3 Illapel, and 2015 Peru-Brazil deep doublet).
limitations_and_caveats: Scope limited to M7+ through 2015; excludes M6.5-6.9 events and post-2015 M7+ events (such as 2019 M8.0 Lagunas us60003sc0).

citation: Hasterok et al. (2022), New Maps of Global Geological Provinces and Tectonic Plates, Earth-Science Reviews 231, 104069
evidence_used: Subplate segmentation across Puna (46), Altiplano (18), North Andes (8), Peruvian (6), South Chile (3), plus 27 eastward-projecting slab events in South American polygon and 19 non-Andean/Nazca/Cocos/Scotia box-overhang events.
limitations_and_caveats: 2D surface polygons assign intermediate/deep eastward-dipping Nazca slab events (110-630 km) to the overriding South American polygon.

citation: Bird (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 4(3), 1027
evidence_used: Plate boundary discretization separating Nazca, South America, Altiplano, North Andes, Panama, Caribbean, Cocos, and Scotia plates.
limitations_and_caveats: Surface boundary discretization only; does not represent 3D Nazca slab contours or flat-slab segments.

citation: Hayes et al. (2018), Slab2, a comprehensive subduction zone geometry model, Science 362(6410), 58-61
evidence_used: 3D Nazca slab geometry reference explaining along-strike flat-slab transitions (Peruvian and Pampean flat slabs) and eastward slab projection at 110-630 km depth.
limitations_and_caveats: Regional 3D slab context; individual event mechanisms require ComCat detail product verification.
